verdict.rationale: Rootly documents Workflows as its automation engine, built from trigger events, run conditions and actions. It lists 152 action types, including incident operations, and says it automates stakeholder updates, channel creation, ticket filing and retros. That covers the core of a condition-based engine triggered by incident events. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of reminder actions and incident field-change actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow engine.
